guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：IEA 15 MW 參考風機
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine
guides.concept: 以開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計解析IEA 15 MW 參考風機：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine through open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識15MW風速功率包絡。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識參考blade氣動。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識參考傳動與generator。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識固定浮式support模型。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識陣列與export cable概念。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識OpenFAST負載驗證。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify 15-mw wind/power envelope in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reference-blade aerodynamics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reference drivetrain/generator in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify fixed/floating support models in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify array/export cable concepts in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify openfast load validation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交陣列與export cable概念的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交OpenFAST負載驗證的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交OpenFAST負載驗證的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for array/export cable concepts.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for openfast load validation.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for openfast load validation.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：容量因數與可用率是同一比例。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.

guides.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

related.title: Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計；Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程改以大型葉片、中速傳動與全功率轉換為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design; Vestas V236-15 MW rotor engineering centers on large blades, medium-speed drivetrain and full converters, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照15MW風速功率包絡與V236風速包絡，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以OpenFAST負載驗證為起點，設計一項能區分「開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計」與「大型葉片、中速傳動與全功率轉換」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare 15-mw wind/power envelope with v236 wind envelope and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Vestas V236-15 MW rotor engineering, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from openfast load validation and propose an observation distinguishing open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design from large blades, medium-speed drivetrain and full converters, including uncertainty.
